cells.quote: The results showed that teachers can develop summarizing skills in students by systematically training them to use these skills, but the training effects decrease if the learning environment does not encourage students to use these skills.
cells.note: The experimental group received explicit teacher modelling, guided practice, independent practice and feedback; the control group followed the mandatory curriculum. Groups were from different schools and were not randomly assigned.
